retention_tricks: Fast Pacing: Quick cuts, rapid text overlays, no dead air.
B-roll & Visual Variety: Constantly changing shots, interesting visuals.
Story Arc/Mini-Cliffhangers: Introduce a problem, build tension, reveal solution.
Text Overlays: Reinforce key points, add humor, guide attention.
Sound Design & Music: Upbeat, trending audio, sound effects for emphasis.
"Show, Don't Tell": Demonstrate concepts visually, minimize talking head.
